Question: Assalamu Alaykum my name is M Saleem and i am living in a village i was ask a q.? from u. but i am not recieve any answer from yet. my Question ID#:24346 i am sorry sir but please answer me so hurry so you can i repeat my Question i am from ludhiana in punjab (India) i am living in a village of 600-650 houses or 2000-2200 liver. All thinge of daily use are availabe here to buy like food and other in daily use. Is juma salat possibe to do. and i wanna to know about all sharat of juma. jazakallah Answer ID: 24407 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1507/1180/B=1431) One of the conditions of Jumuah salah is that the village should be a big one with population of four thousand. There should be bazaar where all the necessities of daily use are available. There should be several streets; and houses should be concrete and streets are also wide and concrete like the streets of town. At present, your village is too small; still wait for a few years. Once your village fulfils the said conditions, then invite two authentic and expert Muftis and get them have an in-depth survey of your village. After the inspection, if they allow offering Jumuah salah then you can start Jumuah salah in your village. At present, you should keep on offering Zuhar salah with jamah. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
